We can see here that the proposal for appointment in the command of the 4th Battalion, Tihomir Misic of the 3rd Brigade of the HVO, and we can see that, for example, the assistant commander under 4 is IPD, and proposal is issued for the battalion commander, the assistant, under 4, for IPD, and the assistant commander for SIS is under 6. Mr. Praljak, this is what the proposal looked like, to the best of your recollection? All of this pertained to the period before your arrival, but I'm just asking you whether this was the principle that was followed.

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN PRALJAK [Resumed]
utterances.text: To be honest, I don't know whether this was the principle or the violation thereof when it came to the IPD and the SIS. One could issue a proposal for the SIS. However, from what I knew, and from what I still know, had to be confirmed by the chief of the SIS itself. Now, as to whether the brigade commander, i.e., the zone brigade, had the right to propose somebody for the SIS, I can't tell you exactly, but in this particular case he did that. This is true, he did issue his proposal.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: Mr. Praljak, I heard from you, and I have taken that into account - you said it yourself, don't ask me about legal norms and how things should have been worded. I'm just showing you how things were in effect, and this is not my point. We can see that the proposal was issued. There's no dispute about that. I'm trying to talk about the way people were appointed and the chain of appointment from the proposal to the actual appointment. This is my topic and this is reflected in the document. My next document is 2D3004. The same topic, we're still talking about the same thing. We have a proposal for deployment, and this was already during the period while you were there, and according to this proposal, Anto -- Bruno Pusic, and this was signed by Major Anto Luburic. I apologise. This is 2D3004. Thank you. 2D3004. A proposal is here issued for the appointment of the 2nd Battalion, Vitez, Ivica Carls Jelcic; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN PRALJAK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: Is that the proposal?

utterances.speaker: SLOBODAN PRALJAK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: Very well. And now we have the following exhibit, which is 2D --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We'll stop now, and we'll resume next week. We have an entire series of documents to look at. Thank you, Ms. Nozica, for having placed them in order. That way it's very easy to follow, rather than skipping from one page to the other. So, please, in the future, could you try and place the exhibits in order? That way, it's much easier for the Judges to follow what's happening. The Registry will -- Registrar will now take stock of the time you've used up so far. You haven't used much. We'll continue next week with your cross-examination, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. Mr. Stringer, do you have anything to say before we finish this session?

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Very quickly. Just one request, Mr. President. One of the documents that counsel referred to so far during the direct was not in Case Map and it was -- I'm sorry, not in e-court. It was probably an oversight. But we're working in e-court, which helps us follow along quickly, and could we just -- it really helps. The Prlic Defence had all of theirs, the books and everything, in e-court, which was very helpful. If perhaps they could just double-check over the weekend to make sure that the documents they're going to use are in e-court, we'd be grateful. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Ms. Nozica, you've heard this, so please check.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes. I would like to thank my learned friend for his observation. We have provided him with a hard copy. I'm going to have a word with my case manager and see why everything is not in e-court. Rest assured, I will deal with this.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Ms. Nozica, you have used up 32 minutes up until now. I wish you all an excellent afternoon, and we will resume on Monday at 2.15. Let's adjourn.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Monday, the 29th day of June, 2009, at 2.15 p.m.

procedural_notes.text: [The accused Prlic and Coric not present]
--- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.45 p.m.,
